question: Find the position vector of the point $R$ which divides the line segment joining $P(-2,1,4)$ and $Q(3,-4,9)$ internally in the ratio $3:2$. Verify the obtained coordinates using the section formula.
explanation:
Step 1: Identification of position vectors
Let $\vec{a}=-2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=3\hat{i}-4\hat{j}+9\hat{k}$.
Step 2: Application of the internal section formula
For $PR:RQ=3:2$,
\(\overrightarrow{OR}=\frac{3\vec{b}+2\vec{a}}{3+2}\)
Step 3: Component-wise calculation
\(\overrightarrow{OR}=\frac{3(3\hat{i}-4\hat{j}+9\hat{k})+2(-2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+4\hat{k})}{5}\)
\(\overrightarrow{OR}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+7\hat{k}\)
Step 4: Coordinate verification
The corresponding coordinates are $R(1,-2,7)$, obtained from $\left(\frac{9-4}{5},\frac{-12+2}{5},\frac{27+8}{5}\right)$.
Final Answer
$\overrightarrow{OR}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+7\hat{k}$.
